item.title: Anthropic Releases Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2 Models
item.description:
Anthropic has launched Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2, claiming gains in coding, reasoning and vision for tackling demanding technical work. Fable 5.2 is now live in Arena's Agent Arena and Code Arena, where it can use web search, filesystem and terminal tools on long-horizon agentic tasks, with leaderboard scores to follow.

Why it matters：Anthropic 双模型同日发布并接入智能体评测场，是值得关注的前沿模型节点。

item.title: Meta Launches Muse Ember Small Model for Agent Workloads
item.description:
Meta has launched Muse Ember, its smallest and most efficient model yet, purpose-built for the routine work AI agents do all day: tool calling, small coding tasks, request routing, data extraction and long-document processing. Meta claims it delivers more intelligence per dollar at every reasoning level than Claude Haiku 5.5 or GPT-6 Luna, at roughly $0.14 per task, though Haiku still leads on real coding benchmarks. The multimodal model handles up to one million tokens and is available now via the Meta Model API and Muse Code at $0.10 per million input tokens and $0.50 per million output tokens.

原文标题：Meta 发布 Muse Ember 小模型 主打智能体高频任务

Why it matters：Meta 以极低单任务成本切入智能体高频调用场景，直接对标 Haiku 与 GPT 小模型，价格与基准数据均具参考价值。

item.title: Australia's Central Bank Warns AI Investment Surge to Lift Inflation First
item.description:
Reserve Bank of Australia Assistant Governor Sarah Hunter said Australia's AI investment surge will lift inflation before any productivity gains arrive. Data centre construction is tightening already-stretched skilled trades and pushing building costs into the CPI, while AI has barely moved headcount yet hiring and employment are weakening in AI-exposed occupations, especially for younger workers. She also warned equities and corporate debt could reprice sharply if AI returns disappoint.

原文标题：澳洲联储警示 AI 投资先推高通胀

Why it matters：央行官员从通胀、就业与资产定价角度量化 AI 投资的宏观副作用，为判断 AI 资本开支周期提供稀缺的政策视角。

item.description:

item.title: Morningstar Values Anthropic at $1.7 Trillion on 47% Growth Forecast
item.description:
Morningstar published a valuation putting Anthropic's equity at roughly $1.7 trillion, about 13x expected 2027 sales, based on a base case of 47% compound annual revenue growth over five years. It attributes growth to deeper spending within existing accounts, untapped Fortune 500 penetration, and low-friction distribution via AWS Bedrock and Google Vertex AI, while rating uncertainty as Very High with a $3T bull case and $500B bear case.

原文标题：晨星给 Anthropic 估值 1.7 万亿美元

Why it matters：这是对头部大模型公司最激进的公开估值之一，其增速假设与护城河判断对理解 AI 商业化成色有参考价值。

item.title: AWS Open Sources Seven-Layer Pluggable Agentic AI Reference Architecture
item.description:
AWS released a seven-layer composable reference architecture for enterprise agentic AI on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, with an open-source sample implementation. It targets the common gap between prototypes and production by front-loading routing, guardrails, observability and security as reusable layers rather than afterthoughts.

item.description:

item.title: Mac App Someone Was Here Uses On-Device Face Recognition to Log Visitors
item.description:
Someone Was Here is a Mac menu bar app that automatically photographs anyone who uses the machine after it has been idle, attempts the lock screen, or unlocks it, logging the time, entry method, and duration of the visit. It runs Apple Vision and Core ML face recognition entirely on-device to distinguish the owner from strangers, with no tracking or ads; real-time remote alerts require a one-time $4.99 purchase via the companion iPhone app.

原文标题：Mac 应用 Someone Was Here 用本地人脸识别记录访客

Why it matters：展示了一个完全本地运行的端侧人脸识别隐私监控工具，对关注端侧 AI 与 Apple 生态开发的读者有参考价值。

item.title: ByteDance Seedream 5.5 Enables 100-Round Pixel-Stable Image Editing
item.description:
ByteDance Seed has unveiled Seedream 5.5, an image generation model aimed at professional production workflows. It supports up to 100 rounds of multi-turn editing with pixel-level preservation of untouched regions and no color drift, and natively outputs RGBA images with transparent backgrounds that can serve directly as design assets. ByteDance claims it outperforms GPT Image 2.5 Sunburst on dense small-text rendering and material realism, with rollout underway via Jimeng, Doubao, Doubao Work and Volcengine Ark, and a Pro version planned.

原文标题：字节 Seedream 5.5 支持 100 轮像素级稳定编辑

Why it matters：多轮编辑的像素级稳定性与原生透明通道直击设计生产痛点，是图像模型向专业工作流落地的重要一步。

item.title: E-means Delivers Up to 45x Faster k-means at Lower Loss
item.description:
Researchers from Meta and École Polytechnique propose e-means, which reaches Lloyd's 25-epoch test loss in just 1.2 to 3 epochs. End-to-end measurements show 10-45x wall-clock speedups on GPU versus Flash-KMeans and 8-15x on CPU versus Faiss, while also achieving lower loss, breaking the usual speed-quality tradeoff in k-means.

原文标题：e-means 让 k-means 提速 45 倍且损失更低

Why it matters：经典聚类算法获得数量级加速且质量不降，对向量检索与大规模数据管线有直接工程价值。

item.title: DeepX Tapes Out Second-Gen Edge AI Chip Running 100B Models Under 5 W
item.description:
South Korean edge AI chip startup DeepX has taped out its second-generation accelerator, the DX-M2, using Samsung's custom processor-in-memory technology to run models of up to 100 billion parameters on-device at under 5 W, delivering 10 to 30 tokens per second. The key leap over the mass-produced, vision-focused DX-M1 is a tripling of memory bandwidth, targeting robots, drones and other generative AI edge devices.

原文标题：DeepX 流片二代边缘 AI 芯片 5 W 内跑 100B 模型

Why it matters：端侧大模型推理的功耗与带宽瓶颈出现具体硬件解法，对关注边缘算力与具身智能的读者有实质参考价值。

item.title: Infineon Unveils Industry-First 300mm SiC Power Wafers
item.description:
Infineon has processed 300mm silicon carbide wafers into functional power devices at its Villach fab, becoming the first company to achieve this in a full-scale semiconductor production environment using existing silicon equipment. The milestone lays the process foundation for scalable, secure SiC supply across automotive, renewable energy, industrial and AI data center applications, with the first processed wafer to be shown at electronica in Munich from 10 November.

item.title: Meta Debuts Muse Ember Small Model at $0.03 per Coding Task
item.description:

Generations averaged about two minutes each, producing 20+ websites and animations in a single pass.
